messages:
jordan.support: FYI customer reported a burst of 503s from hosted inference starting ~08:12 UTC. They saw worker restarts and timeouts. sample request-id: req_9f3a2c, customer: acme-labs.

liz-cs: Customer says errors started right after we switched them to new quantized model variant (v2-q8). They pasted this snippet from their client: `503 Service Unavailable - upstream error` and `context: 0.32s -> dropped`.

ashley-oncall: looking. can you paste the runner logs? i'll check if it's a hot-restart loop or a single segfault. tagging @emma-runtime @mike-infra :eyes:

jordan.support: pasted logs from support ticket below — small redacted chunk:

```
Aug 03 08:12:14 runner-4721 infer-runner[1]: model_swap: loading variant v2-q8
Aug 03 08:12:19 runner-4721 infer-runner[1]: kv_cache:init done
Aug 03 08:12:20 runner-4721 infer-runner[1]: REQ req_9f3a2c pid=3210 ctx=gen sequence=1
Aug 03 08:12:20 runner-4721 infer-runner[1]: cuda: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
Aug 03 08:12:20 runner-4721 infer-runner[1]: fatal: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8c0a2b
Aug 03 08:12:21 systemd: infer-runner[3210] exited with status 139
Aug 03 08:12:22 supervisor: restarted infer-runner (attempt 1)
Aug 03 08:12:23 router: returned 503 to client req_9f3a2c
```

emma-runtime: that `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` immediately before SIGSEGV smells like an OOM during model swap. v2-q8 has a slightly larger temporary working set during kernel init. could be a transient spike on that host.

mike-infra: checking host metrics now — saw memory climb to ~98% of GPU just before the crash, concurrent with a pinned background prefetch job for other tenant. host-id gpunode-11. I can confirm the container was OOM-killed then segfault on kernel call.

ashley-oncall: thanks. can we repro in staging? request: exact steps + workload that triggers swap + batch sizes. if staging repros we can roll a hotfix (limit prefetch, increase reserved headroom).

liz-cs: customer says they hit it with single-threaded requests, not high QPS — just the model swap happened because they enabled automatic variant routing (cost optimization). they want an immediate mitigation: pin back to v2-fp16 for now.

emma-runtime: mitigation steps: 1) pin customer routing to v2-fp16 (no quantized swap) 2) add a temporary capacity headroom rule for gpunode-11 in Dedicated pool (reserve 2GB) 3) rollout a runtime guard: if cuda alloc fails during swap, abort swap and fallback to previous model rather than crash. will open PR.

mike-infra: immediate hotspot: scaled-down prefetch on gpunode-11 and set eviction threshold higher. also I'm triggering an orchestration drain on gpunode-11 for rolling repro and memory checks.

jordan.support: updated ticket: pinned to v2-fp16, customer confirmed errors stopped. asking for postmortem and ETA for runtime guard.

ashley-oncall: short triage notes for oncall playbook: - root cause: transient GPU mem exhaustion during model variant swap for v2-q8 causing cuda alloc failure -> SIGSEGV -> container restart -> client 503s. - impact: small number of customers on gpunode-11, multiple quick restarts 08:12–08:14 UTC, ~120s window. - mitigation: pinned route, drained node, scaled prefetch back. - next actions: emma to open PR for swap guard + tests, infra to add node headroom policy, SRE to run sweep for similar nodes.

emma-runtime: opening PR now: "runtime: abort model_swap on cuda alloc failure and fall back to prior model" — will add unit test and an integration step that simulates a small GPU budget to validate. target next deploy: canary tonight.

sre-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: 5198765432 | upstream-runner-gpu-oom-during-swap -> 503 spike. linked: https://internal.incidents/5198765432 (auto-summary: 22 requests failed, 1 impacted customer).

mike-infra: note for postmortem: also capture kernel messages — I saw an nvlink reset event ~08:11:58 which may have reduced available GPU memory for a few seconds and contributed to the allocation failure. saving dmesg output to /var/log/gpunode-11-dmesg-0812.log

ashley-oncall: folks — please add short repro steps in the ticket: exact API calls, model switch trigger, request payload size, and timing. if anyone has a short reproducer script please paste below.

emma-runtime: repro sketch (staging): 1) deploy v2-fp16 2) enable client automatic variant routing for cost tag 3) concurrently trigger a small prefetch for a different tenant to reduce available GPU memory 4) send a few `generate` requests with context length ~2048 and batch size 1. I've run this with limited GPU headroom and saw the same cuda alloc error during swap. I'll push a repro script to PR.

liz-cs: customer asked about billing for failed requests. jordan — can we credit the failed tokens?

jordan.support: on it. will do a one-time credit for the window 08:12–08:14 UTC and note the workaround.

ashley-oncall: good work team. logging this for the next oncall review. once PR lands we'll schedule a canary and then a full rollout. closing slack thread when postmortem summary is attached to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
